name: HUST wire robot
full_name: HUST 2-DOF friction-wheel guidewire platform for autonomous navigation (centerline-guided)
group: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (Naner Li, Yiwei Wang, Huan Zhao, Han Ding)
target_anatomy: clinical-grade interventional training model (arch and branches)
translation_detail: friction-roller (pair of friction wheels with silicone layer, belt-driven from one motor)
rotation_detail: Wheel pair translated in opposite directions by a screw-driven motor, rubbing the wire to rotate it (Fig. 1d)
imaging_compat: No X-ray: Aurora electromagnetic tip tracking replaces imaging
validation_detail: 96 trials: four methods (manual, trial-and-error, centerline-guided, DTW variant) on several routes, eight repeats per route
key_numbers: Autonomous methods beat manual in trajectory smoothness, length and wrong-branch entries in a static model; manual was fastest (platform speed-limited)
